note: The submitted Ethernet frame bytes become the packet raw buffer consumed by the MIP network parser.
The input Ethernet type selects the IPv4 parsing branch.
The remaining input bytes after the fixed IPv4 header become the IP payload length without using the IP total length field to cap it.
The input-controlled protocol byte selects ICMP handling.
The remaining input bytes after the ICMP header become pkt->pay.len and pkt->pay.buf for the echo payload.
rx_icmp builds an echo reply sized directly from the attacker-controlled payload without checking that Ethernet, IP, ICMP headers plus payload fit in ifp->tx.len.
The oversized ICMP echo payload is copied into the fixed-size transmit buffer after its headers, overflowing the buffer.
